scope: Post-result development choice of reference 18 across nine already-consumed RAW-neutral 1600px JPEG inputs. Not blind selection, independent confirmation, native RAW-resolution validation, training or product promotion.
question: Can the fixed learned VCG pipeline express one chosen photographic reference coherently across the entire nine-input development panel, with useful learned contribution beyond precorrection alone?
selection_history: Reference 18 was deliberately chosen after its prior daisies output had been viewed favourably. All prior three-pair and NCC negatives remain valid; this round is development reuse, never an independent win rate.

reference.author_reported_capture: Captured with a Nikon FM-2 on Kodak Portra 400 film.
reference.author: Nick Rudzicz
reference.appearance_intent: Warm bright areas, cool deep shadows, restrained foliage and soft photographic tonal transitions; no scene, object, lighting or grain reconstruction claim
reference.claim: Author-reported Portra 400 reference, not calibrated Portra output

step_semantics: 25 DDIM inference steps for a pretrained LUT generator, zero training updates
rendering: Existing ICC-aware EXIF-transposed read_rgb; assumed sRGB for these unprofiled JPEG inputs; 512-square bicubic reference conditioning; original input spatial size in final Pillow Color3DLUT rendering

simple_control.arithmetic: float32 then round-to-nearest uint8, matching the original NLUT/VCG control

cache.reuse_requires: Exact source/reference/config/driver/LUT/image hashes and CPU reconstruction of all four cached PNG arms, including dimensions and identical reference decoding/resize/precorrection
cache.missing_or_mismatched_cache: STOP; never silently spend a ninth forward

budget.mechanism: Read-only nvidia-smi admission before output creation and again before worker initialization; supervisor terminates only its own worker at 600 seconds; PyTorch caching allocator fraction plus measured allocated peak guard
budget.rationale: Prospective cap reduced from 9.5 to 8.5 GiB before any forward: prior same-512/25-step inference peaked at 8233958912 allocated bytes (7852.5 MiB), leaving 851.5 MiB allocation headroom plus at least 512 MiB free beyond the new cap. This is a bounded development attempt, not a guarantee against OOM; never automatically increase the budget after failure.
budget.limitations: A snapshot cannot reserve an externally shared GPU; allocator limits do not cap all driver/device allocations. No foreign process or resource may be changed.

attempt_policy: Resource-only deferrals with zero new forwards may retry in a new attempt directory inside this same round. Never overwrite attempts or automatically rerun a partial attempt that started a forward. WDDM process listings with N/A memory are observations, not proof every listed desktop application is computing; known Python compute processes and memory/utilization thresholds still defer admission.
review: Retain and review every input and all four arms at existing input size; separately record learned contribution, coherent reference appearance, photographic preference and severe defects. No best-of selection, independent inference, population preference or product promotion from this consumed panel.
